fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area public affairs, including telephone rate hearings and criticism of utility and regulatory practices, discussion of a proposed sterilization bill in Florida, and a note on milk price disputes. The issue also features extensive horse-racing coverage and tipster content tied to Hialeah and Tropical Park, along with columns and notices about Miami nightlife and entertainment venues and local social items.
